name: Cliveden Woodland Walking Trail
summary: National Trust's circular trail, about 3.2 km, from Cliveden Information Centre, Main Car Park.
start_label: Cliveden Information Centre, Main Car Park
notes: Route line from OpenStreetMap, built on the date shown. Nobody from Driftway has walked it, so surfaces and barriers are as mapped, not as found.

The trail is National Trust's. Check their page on the day for opening times, parking, livestock and conditions: https://www.nationaltrust.org.uk/visit/oxfordshire-buckinghamshire-berkshire/cliveden/cliveden-woodland-walk
National Trust suggests about 1 h to 2 h.
review: built 4.2 km from 2.6 km of mapped paths: going round the gaps adds too much
